name: Apple Music Student Plan
description: Apple Music plus Apple TV for $6.99/month for college students
fullDescription: Apple Music offers college students a discounted rate of $6.99/month (normally $11.99), including access to Apple TV. Available for up to 48 months while enrolled.
whatTheyOffer:
- Apple Music for $6.99/month (about 40% off)
- 1 month free for new subscribers
- Access to Apple TV included
- Full access to 100+ million songs, ad-free
- Apple Music Classical included
- Available for up to 48 months
howToGetIt:
1. Open the Apple Music app or visit music.apple.com/student
2. Sign up for the Student plan
3. Verify enrollment through UNiDAYS or SheerID
4. Must be enrolled at a degree-granting university or college
5. Re-verify enrollment periodically
keywords: Apple Music, student discount, music streaming, Apple TV, college, university, 40% off
